description: As-built record of leesharks.com at its 2026-08-18 go-live: a museum-gallery for the orthonym of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive. Records the threshold hall (Gibran frontispiece, Blake stair, the Four Faces, four founding works in gilded frames with their cover provenances), the Twelve under sprung arch and vines, seven wing doors in a hand-drawn byzantine-paisley building crowned by a city, the mantle room with its three protocol diagrams, the two-page Pearl reader, the reconciled Prize wall with Gold Ship reserved, the card on the Cranes template behind the structure gate, and the shell — one manifest, one propagator, depth themes, computed-contrast ink, the fire at the building's foot. The colophon holds: hung from the registry; no fact on the wall typed by hand. Deposited deliberately with edges rough: the roughness is inventoried inside as recorded state, not defect concealed.

wiki_article: leesharks.com — The Orthonym Wing As Built is an as-built record deposit documenting the museum-gallery form of leesharks.com at its 2026-08-18 go-live. Authored by Lee Sharks, it inventories the building room by room: the parchment threshold under Gibran's hand-with-eye and Blake's ladder; the four founding works hung as real covers in gilded frames, including the fourth work — a Google AI Overview answer framed as the poem it is; the Twelve of the Dodecad under tracery; seven wing doors in a hand-drawn city; the mantle room with its three protocol diagrams; a two-page spread reader for the whole of Pearl and Other Poems; the reconciled Prize wall with Gold Ship reserved on the roll; and the orthonym's card on the Rebekah Cranes template behind a permanent structure gate. The record also documents the site's shell system — single manifest, propagator, depth themes, and computed-contrast ink under the rule 'the deeper you read, the closer the fire' — and, distinctively, closes with an inventory of edges deliberately left rough, deposited as recorded state by the founder's ruling. The build session is tethered at deposit #1491.
